query: INSERT INTO npm_package_versions (id, npm_package_id, version, manifest, shasum, integrity, tarball_storage_key, tarball_size_bytes, origin) SELECT gen_random_uuid(), $1, '1.0.' || n, jsonb_build_object('padding', repeat('a', 1000000)), 'abc', 'sha512-xyz', 'k' || n, 1, 'local' FROM generate_series(1, 32) n
